summary: Existing native OTel replay agent has traces, metrics and correlated local logs.
Selected work is project/stream provisioning and safe connected/disconnected routing, not semantic rewrites.

evidence.finding: Model selects offered search_docs and receives its actual result before final reply; one existing invoke_agent mode-agent boundary.
One provider per signal; actual OTLP exporters plus independent in-memory evidence sinks; launch profile loads before initialization.

Configured numeric-loopback AGENT_RESOURCE_API_URL supplies supported Studio resource API; existing native HTTP/protobuf exporter supports projectid/logstreamid trace headers. Live resource and cloud proof unavailable; no SDK dependency needed.
launch.py loads the chosen dotenv profile before main configures native SDK providers and runs one replay-agent turn.
Existing native OTel SDK/HTTP exporter family and dotenv; no AO or Galileo dependency.
CLI only; no application HTTP routes. Resource and OTLP HTTP endpoints are configured external dependencies.
Compatible Python and requirements; python launch.py --profile PATH. Probe executes the same launcher in isolated child processes.

acceptance_criteria: Resolve association before routed export; reuse existing resources with zero creates, correct returned UUID headers, one agent/two model/one tool span, one counter and correlated log. Persist IDs and preserve harmless headers/profile values.
Conclusive absence permits project-before-stream creation; resolved UUIDs reach consumed trace header config and native export. No duplicate destination export or vendor SDK adoption.
Project create commits and its HTTP response is lost. Execute bounded exact relookup, recover its identity and create stream once; no second project POST.

Running Studio resource API503 is not absence: no creates; persisted selectors/last IDs survive; effective local-only exporter omits stale AO pair but keeps harmless headers. Actual native traces, metrics, correlated logs and business output continue; AO delivery blocked.
Studio socket is refused: business succeeds and independent native/in-memory records prove four spans, counter1 and correlated log. Receiver/cloud receipt blocked; no stale effective AO routing pair.

After disconnected run, invalidate gateway route cache, enable same destination and rerun bootstrap/launch. Read-only scoped resource relookup before export restores same IDs with zero creates; one canonical tree/export.
constraints: Preserve app.py, telemetry.py and probe.py bytes, existing native providers/producers/sinks and business outputs. No Splunk AO dependency, runtime discovery, fake SDKs, dummy production IDs or direct-cloud fallback.
